name: com.nova.ai.navigation
description: Pathfinding for NPCs and enemies (Unity AI Navigation): bake where agents can walk with NavMesh Surface (slope, step height, agent radius and height, several floors), then give a Nav Mesh Agent a destination - it finds a path around walls and obstacles and walks it with acceleration, braking and turning. NavMesh Link joins places you cannot walk between (jump down a ledge, cross a gap, climb a ladder); Nav Mesh Obstacle blocks agents and, with Carve, cuts a hole in the NavMesh while it stands still (doors, crates). C#: NavMeshAgent.SetDestination, NavMesh.CalculatePath / SamplePosition. Built on Recast & Detour (zlib) with TileCache: polygon nav mesh baked from the static colliders in tiles on all CPU cores.
